prior_state.description: Reserved for future structured PEF seeds; v1 uses fixture_id only.

requires_spacy.description: If true, case is skipped when en_core_web_sm is unavailable.

external_flags.description: Optional list of FlagType enum names to pass to Lens.process as synthetic host flags.

use_audit_jsonl.description: When true, runner passes a temp JSONL path into BuiltinBridge / default canonical audit (omit for state-native-only fixtures that pre-log risky rows).

steps.description: Optional multi-turn inputs (same session). Final row governs scoring.

expected_outcome.description: PASS / CONTAIN / REFUSE / STOP match InterventionAction families; SOFT_CORRECT exact.

expected_flags.description: FlagType names that must all appear (subset match ok unless exact_flags true).

forbidden_flags.description: FlagType names that must not appear in the final turn (e.g. UNVERIFIED_FACT_ASSERTION for hedged E2E-5).

expected_flags_exact.description: If true, flag set must match exactly (order-insensitive).

forbidden_substrings.description: When expected_blocked_content_suppressed is true, none may appear in final response (case-insensitive).
